title: M — Exp 9: potentiometer on AIN0 (ADC0 SS3)
summary: ADC0 sample sequencer 3 reads a potentiometer wired to PE3 (AIN0) every 10 ms (PSSI trigger, RIS polling). Turn the knob: green below 1/3 of full scale, blue in the middle, red above 2/3.
expected: Select pot1 and move its Position slider: the LED colour follows the 12-bit ADC result
